long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: The garden plot is where my unknown seeds are, and I intend to see them before anyone else does.
Seeds that grow without permission deserve a close look while nobody is watching.
If the plant is going to grow anything, it will do it on my water.
Dusk is here and my restlessness needs running off around the garden.
The sky is coming out, and the telescope is mine to look through.
The moon still hides its colour, and I will look until it gives up.
steps.topic: the moon's colour through the telescope

steps.reason: My energy is low after all that, and I will recover in a patch of warmth.

today.reason: The garden seeds are the most interesting thing I have, so I will check them, then go to the telescope once dusk falls.
